_note: Otto plans: the single source of truth for what each client brand gets (read by ap.plan_of / ap.entitled / ap.limit; re-read when this file changes, no code change or restart needed). Values follow research/EU-LAUNCH-AND-PRICING-2026-09.md §4.1-4.6. DRAFT: every price (monthly_eur, yearly_eur, extra_brand_eur, founding_bridge) is "status": "draft" until Max approves it; the landing page is not wired to this file. whop_plan_ids stay [] until the subscriptions exist on Whop (founding is the only plan sold today). Yearly = two months free (10 x monthly). A plan with "inherits" takes its parent's features and limits and overrides only what it names (prices, public, upgrade_to, overage and founding_bridge are never inherited). Limits are per brand; null = no limit. posts_per_month counts every organic item (feed posts, carousels, stories and reels); reels_per_month is the reel part of it. ad_spend_managed_eur_month is the plan's band for the monthly paid budget Otto plans (EUR, converted from the brand's currency). It is a SOFT cap: the first month above it is planned in full and the plan card says so; the second month in a row above it is planned at the cap and the card offers upgrade_to. A plan with overage (scale) is never capped: above overage.above_eur_month it shows overage.pct % of the excess (computed and shown, never billed automatically). ad_matrix_preset: none | micro | launch | scale (otto_styles.PRESETS; a daily budget under ~EUR 36 still gets micro). competitor_sweep: false | monthly (the first Monday of the month) | weekly. video_ads_per_month counts Otto-made faceless video ads; creator videos need creator_briefs. public = shown on the pricing page.

defaults._note: legacy = a brand record without a plan (created before plans existed) · new = what onboarding / brand-add write; while that plan has no whop_plan_ids the brand is also flagged plan_billing "not_billed" (not billed yet) until a Whop membership is linked · after_expiry = when brands[].plan_until has passed · unknown = a plan id not in this file (fail-safe: no paid ads) · ended = a canceled / expired Whop membership (publishing paused; otto_retention deletes the brand's data 90 days later unless a plan starts again) · trial = the free trial a new Google sign-up gets on its first brand (otto_trial, docs/AUTH-AND-TRIAL.md); remove it to switch trials off

content.label: Content
content._note: Non-public fallback: organic only, no paid ads (the landing for an expired plan and for an unknown plan id). Research §2: after 60 days, test it at EUR 69 as a cancel-flow downsell.

starter.label: Starter
starter._note: Public entry plan: organic plus Meta ads on the micro matrix (4 concepts x 5 styles), ad spend up to about EUR 1,000 a month. Research §4.1.

growth.label: Growth
growth._note: Adds Google Search ads, the 6 x 6 launch matrix plus 1 refreshed creative per concept a week, creator briefs, weekly competitor sweep. Research §4.1.

scale.label: Scale
scale._note: Up to EUR 15,000 a month on ads with the 6 x 8 scale matrix and 2 refreshed creatives per concept a week; above EUR 15,000, 2% of the excess (shown, not billed automatically). Research §4.1-4.2.

agency.label: Agency
agency._note: From EUR 499 for 5 client workspaces at Starter level (limits are per workspace), +EUR 79 per extra workspace; lifting one workspace to Growth is +EUR 149 (put that brand on growth). Research §4.1.

founding.label: Founding pilot
founding._note: The EUR 197 one-time founding seat (Whop plan_joHl1qsZoiJc9, sold until monthly plans go live): Growth during the pilot. Optional brands[].plan_until ends it; after that date the brand falls back to defaults.after_expiry and the owner gets one recommendation. founding_bridge = the offer each founder gets when plans open (research §4.4): Growth or Starter at a locked price for locked_months, at most seat_cap seats; no automatic charge.

trial.label: Free trial
trial._note: The free trial of a new Google sign-up (otto_trial, docs/AUTH-AND-TRIAL.md): trial_days days, no card, one per Google account and per website domain. Starter's organic, stories, reels, monthly competitor sweep and reports run for real; the monthly ad matrix is planned and rendered for preview, but ads_launch false means no campaign launches (otto_ads launch / otto_cron ads-launch refuse with the reason), and video ads are capped at 3 previews. after_expiry none: when the trial ends without a card the brand pauses (publishing + ads), the data is kept 90 days (otto_retention). checkout_plans = what the "Add a card" screen offers (their whop_plan_ids make the Whop checkout links; prices come from those plans).

none.label: No plan
none._note: A canceled or expired membership: publishing and ad launches pause for the brand, live campaigns are paused by the daily guard, nothing is deleted.
